method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Procaviidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (2 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only procaviids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

sources.role: Official inclusion list; English and Afrikaans species names; species order; absence of asterisk status flags on Procaviidae
Research-grade species counts for Procaviidae in Kruger (place 69020); 2 species in this pull (Procavia capensis, 42; Heterohyrax brucei, 29)
All-grade Procaviidae taxonomy tree for place 69020; used to confirm both official species and that no iNat-only procaviids are present
Current name lists and English preferred names for Procavia capensis and Heterohyrax brucei

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 43086. Rock Dassie and Dassie remain listed English names. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 43088. Yellow-spotted Rock Hyrax and Yellow Spotted Dassie remain listed English names. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name, with the typographic space in the PDF's 'Yellow -spotted' closed up.

notes: The 2011 checklist prints the English name as 'Yellow -spotted rock dassie' (space around the hyphen). The stored en value is Yellow-spotted rock dassie.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Procaviidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
